title: Back-to-back Part Gap Fusion on 0.6mm Nozzle
finding: Parallel surfaces separated by <= 0.75 mm fuse solidly when sliced with 0.6 mm nozzle profiles (line width 0.62 mm) in PLA. Gaps must be >= 1.0 mm or use staggered single-band tacks.

rule_proposal.why: Surfaces within 0.75 mm fuse during 0.6mm printing, preventing parts from twisting or snapping apart.
rule_proposal.fix: Increase spacing between back ribs to at least 1.0 mm, or replace continuous seams with staggered point tacks.
